**Retrieve Attribution Trigger Information**

This example demonstrates how to fetch attribution trigger data.

```typescript
// Assuming 'client' is an initialized Dice API client
async function getAttributionTrigger() {
  try {
    const attributionData = await client.attribution_trigger();
    console.log("Attribution Data:", attributionData);
    return attributionData;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching attribution data:", error);
    return null;
  }
}

getAttributionTrigger();
```

**Create a New Job Posting**

This example shows how to create a new job posting using the `/jobs` endpoint.

```typescript
async function createJob(jobData: any) {
  try {
    const response = await client.jobs(jobData);
    console.log("Job creation response:", response);
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error creating job:", error);
    return null;
  }
}

// Example job data (replace with your actual data)
const newJobData = {
  title: "Software Engineer",
  description: "Looking for a talented software engineer...",
  location: "New York, NY",
  // ... other job details
};

createJob(newJobData);
```
